Crowns that organizers place on the map, giving a fixed Crown Points (CP) reward. Depending on the crown you can collect it once, or over and over – each day or each week. Some crowns can only be collected by a limited number of members and disappear once that limit is reached.

Appear on their own near places around the area, in different rarities (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary) – the rarer the crown, the more CP. They have a time limit and disappear on their own when it runs out, even if no one collected them. A rare or legendary crown is taken by the first person to collect it and then disappears immediately for everyone else.
Does a crown disappear once I collect it?

A crown you have already collected can\'t be collected again. Common and uncommon crowns can be collected by several members separately and stay on the map until their time runs out or they reach their limit. Exclusive crowns (rare and legendary) disappear for everyone the moment someone takes them.

Crown Hunt is a hunt for crowns that appear on the map around the area. Drive near a crown, stop, and collect it to earn Crown Points (CP), climb the leaderboard and unlock Crown Hunter ranks.

1. Drive near a crown on the map.
2. Stop or slow right down – you can collect a crown while stationary or moving very slowly. Never drive carelessly to reach one.
3. Tap the crown, then tap Collect. The app quickly confirms you're stopped before the crown is yours – there's no timer, so take your time.
Keep an eye on the map as you drive and you'll see crowns appear around you.
Crowns come in four rarities. The rarer the crown, the more points it\'s worth.
The most common of all and worth the fewest points. Several members can each collect the same crown.
A little rarer and worth a bit more. Several members can still each collect it.
Scarce and worth much more. The first person to reach it takes it – then it\'s gone for everyone else.
The rarest of all and worth the most. Only one person gets to take it before it\'s gone.

Common and uncommon crowns are shared – several members can each collect the same crown, and it stays on the map for a while. Rare and legendary crowns are exclusive – whoever gets there first takes them, and then they disappear for everyone else immediately. A crown you\'ve already collected can\'t be collected again.

Every crown has a time limit and disappears on its own when it runs out – even if no one collected it. Rarer crowns tend to stick around a little longer, but don\'t wait too long: grab them while they\'re there.
Where and how often do crowns appear?

New crowns appear regularly near places where there\'s life and activity – the busier a place, the more likely a crown shows up there. Rarer crowns are, well … rarer. Exactly when and where the next crown appears is part of the hunt, so keep an eye on the map.
Every crown you collect gives Crown Points (CP). Rarer crowns give more. Your CP add up to your place on the season leaderboard and can be spent in the shop where available.

The more crowns you collect in total, the higher the Crown Hunter rank you unlock: Bronze at 10 crowns, Silver at 50, Gold at 250 and finally Platinum at 1,000. The rank is tallied on the server from all the crowns you\'ve collected – it appears automatically as soon as you reach it.
Collecting a crown while sharing a live session earns full Crown Points. Without live sharing, you earn fewer points.
